mission: Ensure changed executable code cannot be labeled release-ready solely because unrelated tests pass.

normal: at least one changed test file or focused verification mapping
high: rollback or safe-revert evidence when applicable

exemptions.rule: Exemptions are temporary, explicit, reviewable, and cannot be used for critical payment/auth/security/destructive behavior changes.

release_blockers: changed executable file has no verification evidence and no valid exemption
shared-core change lacks dependent-system regression evidence
truth_rule: Relevant test mapping improves confidence but cannot prove absence of every defect.
